Goblin_Melee
Ripper, named Goblin Brawler in-game, is a goblin who only can be encountered during the goblin camp celebration if the party betrayed the Emerald Grove during Act One.

Involvement

Ripper can be found sitting on a log at the camp at night along with other goblins who are celebrating and drinking. When approached, he immediately offers the party a "gift from the battlefield". If the party had met  Alfira before, the talking party member realizes that the gift is a lute belonging to Alfira, and can either tell him to keep it or accept the gift. If the gift is accepted, Ripper hands over  Alfira's Lute.

The party member can optionally use their tadpole to command Ripper to hand over the lute and anything else he is holding. Passing the role grants the lute and an extra  Longsword, whereas failing the roll grants the lute and a  Heart.
